names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 18 mai, «Sfânta Hristina și cele 7 sfinte fecioare împreună cu ea».
The spelling the linked life uses for her: «Sfânta fecioară Cristina».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 18 Μαΐου, «Άγιοι Πέτρος, Διονύσιος, Ανδρέας, Παύλος, Χριστίνα, Ηράκλειος, Παυλίνος και Βενέδιμος οι Μάρτυρες», with the rank word left off.

death.note: doxologia.ro's page for her: «Sfânta Hristina a trăit în secolul al III-lea, în timpul împăratului Deciu»; the other life the day links says only «pe vremea împărăției lui Deciu», with no year.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 18 mai — «Sfânta Hristina și cele 7 sfinte fecioare împreună cu ea»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 18ης Μαΐου — «Άγιοι Πέτρος, Διονύσιος, Ανδρέας, Παύλος, Χριστίνα, Ηράκλειος, Παυλίνος και Βενέδιμος οι Μάρτυρες»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 18 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same civil day the Romanian calendar already keeps him on, and its closing verse agrees: «Ὀγδοάς, Ἀθλοφόρων ἐκ γαίης εἰς πόλιν ἤρθη». **One page carries eight head names and the corpus keeps four of them**, so this company is four upgrades and four new folders in batch `el-05-18` — Andrew and Paul of Mesopotamia, Heraclius and Benedimus of Athens. **The Greek dates the whole company by one reign and no year**: «Όλοι αυτοί οι Άγιοι μαρτύρησαν στα χρόνια του αυτοκράτορα Δεκίου (249-251 μ.Χ.)», so no `dates` object is added or altered here. **Two hymns of the company are copied**, an apolytikion in Ἦχος δ’ that names all eight and a kontakion in the same tone; both are the company's own service and neither is a mis-hang. **She is the one woman of the eight**, and the page's couplet for her — «Xριστώ παρέστης ηγλαϊσμένη όλη, Aίμασι τοις σοις παρθενική Xριστίνα» — calls her virgin, which the folder's `types` already carries. **The page gives her no city and no age**, only that she was stoned with Paul, Andrew and Dionysius at Athens; the existing `dates` object is not touched, the Greek adding only Decius's reign. **She is not the corpus's Christina the great martyr of 24 July** and nothing here attaches her to that one.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).

hymns.text: Mucenicii Tăi, Doamne, întru nevoinţele lor, cununile nesctricăciunii au dobândit de la Tine, Dumnezeul nostru. Că având tăria Ta, pe chinuitori au învins; zdrobit-au şi ale demonilor neputincioase îndrăzniri. Pentru rugăciunile lor, mântuieşte sufletele noastre, Hristoase Dumnezeule.

source.text: doxologia.ro, «Troparul Sfinților Mucenici Petru, Dionisie, Paulin și al Sfântului Mucenic Teodot și al celor șapte», Glasul 4 — the troparion her own page carries, printed for all the martyrs of the day

english.text: Thy martyrs, O Lord, in their contests received the crowns of incorruption from Thee our God; for having Thy strength, they cast down the tyrants and broke the feeble insolence of the demons. At their prayers, O Christ our God, save our souls.

hymns.text: Τῶν ἀθλοφόρων τὸν ὀκτάριθμον δῆμον, μαρτυρικοὶς ἐγκωμιάσωμεν ὕμνοις, Παυλῖνον Διονύσιον καὶ Πέτρον ὁμοῦ, Ἀνδρέαν καὶ Βενέδιμον, τὸν θεόφρονα Παῦλον, Ἡράκλειον τὸν ἔνδοξον, καὶ Χριστίναν τὴν θείαν οὗτοι καὶ γὰρ πρεσβεύουσιν ἀεί, ὑπὲρ τοῦ κόσμου. Χριστῷ τῷ θεῷ ἠμῶν.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον (Κατέβασμα), Ἦχος δ’, Ὃ ὑψωθεῖς ἐν τῷ Σταυρῷ, on the page of the eight martyrs of 18 Μαΐου

english.text: Let us praise with martyrs' hymns the eight-numbered company of the victors: Paulinus, Dionysius and Peter together, Andrew and Benedimus, God-minded Paul, glorious Heraclius and divine Christina; for these intercede always for the world with Christ our God.

hymns.text: Διαφόρων πόλεων ἐξωρμημένοι, οὐρανίου πόλεως, πολῖται ὢφθητε σεπτοί, χορόν λαμπρόν συγκροτήσαντες Μάρτυρες θεῖοι, Τριάδος ὑπέρμαχοι.

source.text: saint.gr, Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος δ’, Ἐπεφάνης σήμερον, on the page of the eight martyrs of 18 Μαΐου

english.text: Setting out from different cities, you were shown to be honoured citizens of the heavenly city, forming one bright choir, divine martyrs, champions of the Trinity.
